lemma skyward : Rate G L (-(23/20)) (fun x=> planks G L b σ x):= by
  have hb := (rows G L b).2.2.1
  apply sparks G L (f:=fun i x=> |Slide.ray i| * (_) ); intro i
  simpa only [zero_add] using! ((((Bolt.still ((2:ℝ)^σ.order)).times (((Bolt.still 1).joins hb).nod (σ.power*σ.order))).uses.mul (Trio.frost G L b σ i)).mul_left |Slide.ray i|)

proof_context.conclusion: The reflected-term bound planks has rate beta^{-23/20}, its prefactors being fixed powers of 1+B.

lemma scaleMeters (b : ℕ) (B : ℕ) (hx:1 ≤ B) (x:Site c) (u:ℕ) (hp:u≤2*base b B):
    coverNumber B (neighbors u x) ≤ (Trio.maxFixed b+Trio.maxFixed b+1)^4:= by
  apply (Corona.cover_mono ?_ B).trans (Corona.tile x (maxFixed b) B hx); intro i hi; exact halo_spec.mpr ⟨x,mem_singleton_self _,((neighbors_mem ..).1 hi).trans (hp.trans (Trio.roof b B hx))⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The cover number of a neighbourhood of radius at most 2*base b B is at most (2 maxFixed b + 1)^4, a stage constant.

lemma compar (G : Gauge) (L:Side) (b : ℕ) (P: RG.Stage): ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
    let u:=gold G L x; let z:= Height.away P
    z*u+u+ z*(planks G L b P x* Real.exp (stout P * coverTicket b)) ≤ (1/2:ℝ)*(Time.credit G P*δE x):= by
  have ht : Rate G L (-(23/20)) (gold G L) := Rate.power
  have hh := (((ht.mul_left (away P)).add ht).add (((Trio.skyward G L b P).mul_right (Real.exp (stout P * coverTicket b))).mul_left (away P)))

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually, the regular bound built from gold and planks is at most (1/2) credit * deltaE x, deltaE having exponent -11/10.

lemma worthy (x:ℝ) (p:Site A₀):
    Trio.Tidy B (neighbors (2*e) p) (lights H he W d x p) ∧ (∀ V,lights H he W d x p V≠0→¬Healthy (B).threshold (neighbors (2*e) p) V) ∧ (∀ V, ‖lights H he W d x p V‖ ≤ tempe (m:=m) (A:=A) (C:=C) (Z:=Z)):= by

proof_context.conclusion: The localization correction is tidy on N_{2e}(p), vanishes unless N_{2e}(p) is unhealthy, and has sup at most tempe.

lemma cheap (ht:t=-(7/16:ℝ)): ∀ᶠ x in atTop,Marlin.tithe (2*base b (radiusB x)) (lossFee G L t b σ x) ⟨σ.power,σ.order, σ.supportExponent,1,1,σ.power_ge,σ.order_ge,σ.price_pos,Nat.zero_lt_one,zero_lt_one,le_rfl⟩ (coverTicket b) ≤ betaF G x L ^(-(1/8):ℝ):= by
  have ht' := ((balls G L ((rows G L b).2.2.2)).mul (twigs G L t b σ ht)).mul_right (Real.exp ((σ.supportExponent+1+1)*coverTicket b)) (-(1/8):ℝ) (by rw [ht]; norm_num)
  filter_upwards [ht'] with x hv; exact (le_abs_self _).trans hv

proof_context.conclusion: With lossFee of rate beta^{-7/16} (twigs) and cover number at most coverTicket, the site norm at exponent supportExponent+2 of the corrections is eventually at most beta^{-1/8}.
